patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BookYourData and Hunter share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose BookYourData only if your buying job matches “Real-time B2B contact database for building verified prospect lists with pay-as-you-go cre” rather than Hunter's shape. Choose Hunter only if your buying job matches “Domain email finder, verifier, and cold email sequences (All-in-one) — Free 50 credits; St” rather than BookYourData's shape. Workflow advantage: BookYourData leans lead-management; Hunter leans data-enrichment. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BookYourData and Hunter share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

- Workflow coverage skew: BookYourData-leaning lead-management vs Hunter-leaning data-enrichment.
- Researched limits: BookYourData — none listed; Hunter — Contact data is email/domain-centric — weaker as a full phone+firmographic mega-database.
